message.content: An editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover. A central portrait of a smiling man with glasses, wearing a dark suit and tie, is set within an ornate, rectangular wooden frame. This frame hangs against a textured, beige wall with a faded, floral pattern. A hand wearing a light blue glove enters from the left edge, holding a wooden-handled brush. The brush's head is composed of folded paper currency instead of bristles. This money brush is positioned as if dusting the man’s portrait. Bold white text at the bottom reads "BERSIH-BERSIH MISBAKHUN". Above this, the word "TEMPO" is printed in large, white, serif capital letters across the top of the frame. Smaller text at the top reads "INVESTIGASI: CALO GAS BLOK TANGGUH" in yellow and white. Below the main title, a caption in black text reads: "Hakim agung kasus L/C Bank Century yang melibatkan politikus PKS ini ditengarai menerima suap." Additional details include a date "EDISI 3-9 DESEMBER 2012," a price "RP 29.700," a website, and a barcode.
